01

Our story

The name “Chisi” is rooted in Shona tradition. It refers to a customary day of rest, during which certain activities—particularly agricultural work—may be restricted in observance of community customs and respect for the land. For our firm, this heritage provides a powerful symbolic foundation: lasting progress begins with discipline, stewardship and respect for the principles that sustain communities and enterprise.

We interpret this heritage through a contemporary commercial lens. We seek opportunities that can be carefully assessed, properly structured and developed into sustainable businesses. Our outlook is rooted in Zimbabwe while remaining open to opportunities and partnerships across the wider African region.

02

Who we are

Chisi Capital Partners is a project development, investment structuring and capital mobilisation firm focused on commercially viable opportunities in Zimbabwe and Africa. Our work combines project origination, commercial analysis, financial structuring and engagement with potential capital providers, with particular emphasis on industrial and productive-sector ventures.

03

Vision

To become a trusted project development and investment structuring partner in Zimbabwe and the wider African region, converting untapped economic opportunities into commercially sustainable enterprises that advance industrialisation, value addition and economic growth.

04

What guides us

Commercial discipline

We test assumptions and prioritise commercially sound fundamentals.

Long-term thinking

We evaluate value creation beyond the initial transaction.

Local understanding

We recognise the opportunities and practical realities of Zimbabwean and regional markets.

Partnership

We collaborate with specialists and institutions whose expertise strengthens projects.

Responsible progress

We respect due diligence, mandates, regulatory requirements and investment approvals.

05

Our role alongside CIE

CIE mobilises entrepreneurial ideas and supports incubation. Chisi undertakes suitable opportunities for further commercial assessment, project preparation and potential investor engagement. Referral or collaboration does not imply project acceptance, financing or investment approval.
